templates.name: Akai APC mini mk2
templates.notes: Top rows: hit pads, build, tap, next look / effect. Row 3: override keys. Bottom 4 rows: loop banks A-D. Faders 1-6: MASTER, SPEED, STROBE, COLOR, WHITE, TRAILS (fader 9 = MASTER too). Track buttons 1-6: the fader hold keys. Scene buttons: Song Show on, record, skip, interlude, stop loops, release overrides, previous look / effect.
verify: Shift note 122 (not used by this layout)
blink / pulse / dim LED channels (we use ch 15 = blink, ch 10 = pulse, ch 3 = dim; ch 7 = 100 % is confirmed)

templates.name: Akai APC40 mkII
templates.notes: Top grid row: 8 hit pads; row 2: 4 more pads, build, next look / effect; row 3: override keys; rows 4-5: loop banks. Track faders 1-6 = MASTER, SPEED, STROBE, COLOR, WHITE, TRAILS (master fader = MASTER). Clip Stop 1-6: fader hold keys. Scene launch: Song Show on, record, skip, interlude, release overrides. Stop All Clips: stop loops. Tap Tempo: tap. Nudge: effect back / next.
verify: clip grid notes 0-39 on channel 1 (top row 32-39): mkII layout from forum captures, not an official chart
mkII RGB palette and LED channels (we use the APC mini mk2 palette, ch 1 solid, ch 15 blink)
faders, knobs, scene / stop-all / tap / nudge numbers checked against the APC40 (mk1) protocol only
mode byte 0x42 (Ableton alternate mode: momentary buttons, host-lit LEDs)

templates.name: Novation Launchpad Mini MK3
templates.notes: Programmer mode. Top row: 8 hit pads; row 7: 4 more pads, build, tap, next look / effect; row 6: override keys; row 5: fader hold keys; rows 1-4: loop banks A-D. Right-hand column: Song Show on, record, skip, interlude, stop loops, release overrides, previous look / effect.
verify: right-hand column CC 19-89 and top row CC 91-98 (from the Programmer diagram, not its text)
which Windows interface takes Programmer mode (we send it to every LPMiniMK3 output)

templates.name: Novation Launchpad X
templates.notes: Same layout as the Launchpad Mini MK3 (Programmer mode).
verify: Launchpad X device byte 0x0C in the Programmer-mode SysEx
grid / side numbers assumed the same as the Mini MK3

templates.name: Novation Launch Control XL
templates.notes: Factory template 1. Faders 1-6: MASTER, SPEED, STROBE, COLOR, WHITE, TRAILS. Top button row: 8 hit pads. Bottom button row: 8 override keys. Device: tap, Mute: build, Solo: interlude, Record Arm: release overrides. Left / right: previous / next look; up / down: next / previous effect.
verify: Device / Mute / Solo / Record Arm notes 105-108
only factory template 1 (channel 9); other templates use other channels
not for the Launch Control XL 3 (new MIDI map)

templates.name: Generic 8 pads + 8 knobs
templates.notes: Pads on notes 36-43 (channel 10 or 1) fire the first 8 hit pads. Knobs on CC 70-75 ride the 6 faders, CC 76 / 77 step the look / effect. Re-learn anything that does not line up with your pads.
verify: a common default (Akai MPK mini / LPD8 style); every controller differs, so this one is a starting point
